profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 25+ years of experience designing and delivering secure, mission-critical solutions across federal and commercial environments. I specialize in Java-based distributed systems, real-time data processing, and scalable backend applications that support operational analytics and decision-making.
 
My experience includes full-stack development with a strong backend focus, leveraging Java, Spring Boot, and modern data platforms. I have worked extensively in Agile environments, contributing to the design, development, testing, and integration of complex systems in high-security, cleared (DoD) settings.
 
Throughout my career, I have led technical efforts while remaining hands-on—mentoring teams, improving system performance, and resolving complex issues within distributed architectures.
 
I am passionate about building reliable, scalable systems and am currently seeking senior-level software engineering opportunities where I can contribute to high-impact application development and system design.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Develop and support Java 11 applications on Linux-based platforms, ensuring system stability, scalability, and performance.
· Drive modernization efforts for next-generation Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) solutions by applying commercial and government security best practices for secure key management and authentication services.
· Plan, implement, and evaluate PKI solution architectures to support enterprise modernization initiatives and evolving cybersecurity requirements.
· Collaborate with Development, Engineering, Architecture, and Test teams to define tools, processes, and automation strategies supporting continuous delivery pipelines.
· Develop software solutions that satisfy cybersecurity-related requirements, security constraints, and compliance objectives within secure enterprise environments.
· Advocate for automation across the software lifecycle, including build, deployment, testing, monitoring, and system updates.
· Participate in software planning activities including development planning, build planning, sprint planning, and technical design discussions.
· Apply modern software design patterns and engineering methodologies to support maintainable, scalable, and secure solutions.
· Contribute to containerized application builds using Docker and support CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Maven, and Gradle.
· Partner with stakeholders and customers to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver solutions aligned with business and operational needs.
· Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
· Developed and enhanced Apache Flink (Java API) streaming applications to process, transform, and aggregate high-volume data for mission-critical analytics.
· Integrated enterprise data sources and Amazon S3 storage with Apache Flink applications to support high-volume data processing and analytics.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and supported enterprise systems using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data, and JEE components, ensuring scalable and maintainable software.
• Built secure, data-driven applications across Oracle and PostgreSQL environments.
• Created RESTful web services and UI components using JavaScript, AngularJS, HTML, XML, and JSON.
• Applied secure coding practices using cryptographic technologies including encryption, digital signatures, and XML canonicalization.
• Utilized IDEs, source control, and CI/CD tools (Eclipse, VS Code, WebStorm, Git, Maven, Jenkins) to support high-quality delivery.
• Practiced Agile engineering techniques, including TDD, refactoring, pair programming, and support for BDD in Scrum/SAFe environments.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
• Engaged with product team to identify technical needs and develop requirements
• Assessed and tracked software/hardware system requirements and project status
• Lead projects through full life cycle development in an Agile software environment
• Identified and tracked project milestones
• Planned and allocated resources
• Projected and tracked costs and schedules
• Articulate project status to decision makers and stakeholders

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and supported enterprise systems using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data, and JEE components, ensuring scalable and maintainable software.
• Designed, developed, and implemented custom software application capabilities imagery systems using Java, Spring Boot, REST, using a Modernized Integrated Database (MIDB).
• Actively participate on Agile development team in release and sprint planning, artifact creation, sprint testing, regression testing, demonstrations and retrospectives and solution releases.
• Analyze complex project-related problems and creating innovative solutions involving, scheduling, technology, methodology, tools, and solution components
• Supported production environments by troubleshooting and resolving system issues to ensure reliability and performance
• Provided mentoring to junior members of the team. 
• Supported CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment efficiency and reliability 
• Experience with Docker containers to create Docker images/containers. 
• Supported production systems and provided technical guidance to ensure system stability and performance in mission-critical environments

positions.title: Software Engineer (Senior-Level / Technical Lead)
positions.description:
• Worked on a team maintaining a web-based application using an AngularJs and Java Technologies. 
• Led a small team in the design and development of an organization wide tool and back-end processing capabilities for system enhancement. 
• Implemented RESTful services to expose data to customers and consume data from sources, perform statistical analysis on the data, and stored into a cloud environment or relational databases such as Oracle, MongoDB, and Postgres. 
• Designed and recommended technical solutions for IT related issues. 
• Involved in Daily Scrum meetings, Sprint planning and estimation, documentation, and completion of task for user stories. 
• Used Maven to build and Jenkins to deploy the application to Tomcat. 
• Used Junit and Mockito for unit testing 
• Used Atlassian Jira to manage produce backlog, and "trouble tickets" in an Agile Development Environment. 
• Used GitHub for code repository and conduct code reviews.
• Developed and maintained ETL (Extract, Transform, and Load) framework for merging data from multiple diverse sources to serve basic analytic development.
• Environment: JDK 1.8, Restful Web services, HTML5, CSS, AngularJS, JavaScript, jQuery, Junit, Mockito, Maven, Jenkins, GitHub, Tomcat

company.name: Innovative Systems & Solutions Inc - Annapolis Junction, Maryland

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on technical teams to maintain a web application for a Department of Defense (DOD) customer in an Agile SCRUM development environment. 
• Worked on multiple projects, preformed server-side development and UI development using Spring Boot, Java, JavaScript, Angular JS, ExtJS, HTML5, CSS, Maven, Git, Oracle and Postgres databases on Linux in an Apache Tomcat Application Server. 
• Developed Microservices using Java and Spring Boot, including the use of Swagger documenting and test REST APIs and deployment into Eureka Cloud Foundry 
• Used ORM frameworks like Spring JPA and Hibernate 
• Configured Spring Boot applications using YAML configuration files
• Used Bamboo for continuous integration for microservices and Junit to create unit tests.
• Used Atlassian tool suite (Jira and Crucible) to manage produce backlog conduct and participate in code reviews providing guidance to software developers for continuous improvement. 
• Component technical lead for implementation of functionality with software application.

company.name: Advanced Computer And Network Concepts L.L.C.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained UI components using Angular, JavaScript, and CSS for enterprise applications
• Built backend business processes using Java and Oracle on a JBoss application server
• Managed application builds and version control using Maven and Git
• Participated in code reviews and provided technical guidance to improve code quality and team performance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained Java-based web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and MongoDB on a JBoss application server in a Linux operation system. 
• Designed and implemented data processing pipelines using MapReduce (Java, PIG) for analytics 
• Developed and maintained ETL (Extract, Transform, and Load) framework to integrate data from multiple sources 
• Built RESTful services to expose data to customers and consume data from sources, perform statistical analysis on the data, and stored into a cloud environment. 
• Used TestNG for unit test and Bamboo for continuous integration. 
• Used Atlassian software development and collaboration tools to include Jira, Confluence, and Crucible

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed streaming analytics applications using IBM InfoSphere Streams and StreamBase CEP
• Built custom Java algorithms to process and load data into streaming modules
• Designed Java applications to process JMS (ActiveMQ) messages and store results in Oracle and Solr
• Participated in Agile development and supported application deployment on Apache Tomcat

positions.title: Lead Java Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed web applications using Eclipse IDE, Java and other technologies Hibernate, JDBC, JNDI, Ant, Java Server Pages (JSP), HTML, JavaScript, on a Tomcat application server.
• Incorporated in the new application forms, reports, and modified the framework using custom tag libraries. 
• Utilized the Tool for Oracle Application Developers (TOAD) to perform database administration to include schema design and modification, stored procedures, and triggers. 
• Evaluate and documented project requirements and processes and prepared application specifications. 
• Maintained the Oracle database including schema design and modification, stored procedures, and triggers.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: • Led development efforts as a team developer, designing and maintaining database-driven web applications using Java, ColdFusion, HTML, and JavaScript to support enterprise data systems and customer-facing applications.

positions.title: Maintenance Officer
positions.description:
• Planned, organized, and supervised all direct support service maintenance on wheel and recovery vehicles for over 30 customer units. 
• Led and supervised 60 plus military service members.
• Mentored and guided soldiers in their career path 
• Provided maintenance and accountability for property books for the entire unit.
